items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: And I stayed with Chester for 2 years -- from '34 to '36

ctx.x: That's the way it was. And if you didn't do that, I couldn't go, see? During those days, parents were strict, and mine were very strict.

Now, we went out like 3 months all over the state of Louisiana, because he is from Louisiana. I come back here and I go back to school in September. Now, on that band was a guy by the name of Chester Boone that liked my playing, and he had formed a band in Houston, and went into the Harlem Grill here in Houston, Texas.
